in_scope.instructions: This domain hosts the API for our mobile and PC games. Monitoring traffic through one of our game clients is the easiest method to investigate our main API. Most of our applications are available for free on [Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/developer/ninjakiwigames/#browse). Please carefully read the in-scope section regarding what sorts of exploits will be considering in-scope for this domain.

in_scope.instructions:
Please note that the ninjakiwi.com domain has a number of subdomains which are not in-scope. These are domains which are managed by third party providers. This includes (but it not limited to):
- support.ninjakiwi.com
- store.ninjakiwi.com
- btd6store.ninjakiwi.com
- battles2store.ninjakiwi.com

If you are unsure please feel free to reach out to us at security@ninjakiwi.com.
